newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AVI half-yr pre-excep shr slips, no div.
newsitem.headline: AVI half-yr pre-excep shr slips, no div.

text.p: NOTE - The group said the disappointing results should be seen in the context of major investments aimed at meeting the challenges and opportunities arising from the opening of South Africa's economy.

It said major capital expenditure programmes and transformation initiatives focused on achieving internationally competitive low cost producer status were well advanced, but the implementation was having a disruptive short-term effect on the production in some group operations.

Any improvemnet for the whole year on the decline in earnings reported for the first half-year would be largely dependent on the economic climate and the successful completion of various of the group's initiatives. The full benefit of these programmes would manifest themselves during the 1998 financial year.
